description: This file contains ARM64 assembly code for cryptographic operations in BoringSSL's BSAES implementation, including AES encryption/decryption, key schedule, and related routines, with constants and functions for AES in ARMv8 architecture.

methods.name: _vpaes_encrypt_preheat
methods.description: Prepares constants and registers for AES encryption in ARMv8 assembly.

methods.name: _vpaes_encrypt_core
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on a 128-bit block using ARM assembly.

methods.name: vpaes_encrypt
methods.description: Public function to encrypt a block with AES using ARM assembly routines.

methods.name: _vpaes_decrypt_preheat
methods.description: Prepares constants and registers for AES decryption in ARMv8 assembly.

methods.name: _vpaes_decrypt_core
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on a 128-bit block using ARM assembly routines.

methods.name: vpaes_decrypt
methods.description: Public function to decrypt a block with AES using ARM assembly routines.

methods.name: _vpaes_encrypt_2x
methods.description: Optimized double-block AES encryption routine for ARM64.

methods.name: _vpaes_decrypt_2x
methods.description: Optimized double-block AES decryption routine for ARM64.

methods.name: _vpaes_key_preheat
methods.description: Loads constants and tables for AES key schedule in ARM assembly.

methods.name: _vpaes_schedule_core
methods.description: Performs core key schedule operations for AES in ARM assembly.

methods.name: _vpaes_schedule_transform
methods.description: Transforms key schedule data according to tables in ARM assembly.

methods.name: _vpaes_schedule_mangle
methods.description: Mangles the key schedule for last round, with different behavior for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: _vpaes_schedule_round
methods.description: Runs one main round of the key schedule, including subbytes, rotation, and rcon addition.

methods.name: _vpaes_schedule_low_round
methods.description: Performs a low-round key schedule operation, used in 192/256-bit key schedules.

methods.name: _vpaes_schedule_192_smear
methods.description: Smears the low side in 192-bit key schedule.
